notes.title: Now 3 difficulty levels available
notes.content:
When you start the game you can pick a difficulty level, which can be easy, normal, or hard. 
[list]
[*] [b]Hard[/b] is the original difficulty with several additional threats added. 
[*] [b]Normal[/b] has additional support platforms. 
[*] [b]Easy[/b] has additional respawn points, which look like green checkpoints. Just to let you know, they are not checkpoints, to save your progress you need to reach a blue checkpoint.   
[/list]
